== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Imperial Squad Leader (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Imperial Squad Leader (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip, each as cut from its sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>fa62a6e0cc64c1cac14815174818cc16ae2457df</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
